item.title: Agentic iOS development with RocketSim and RocketTrace
item.description:
Agentic iOS development changes a lot once your coding agent can see and measure the app it's building. Without that, an agent writes code, hopes it works, and asks you to run the app. With tools like RocketSim and RocketTrace, agents get real observability into builds, runtime behavior, and performance — closing the loop between writing code and verifying it.

The takeaway: the agents aren't the bottleneck anymore; the feedback loop is. Tooling that gives agents eyes on the simulator is where the next iOS productivity gains live.
